title: Diagnostic registry
description: Every diagnostic code a document of one family version may report: core's codes, those of each normative dependency, and the family's own, as registry/diagnostics.json projects them from the diagnostics and warnings tables of each spec.md. spec.md is normative: the file is generated from it by task docs, and a file that disagrees with it fails task check:docs. Within a major version a code is never removed and its phases never shrink.

family.description: The family whose documents may report these codes.

major.description: The major version directory, such as v2.

diagnostics.description: Every reachable code: core's first, then each dependency's in the order the family's §2 lists them, then the family's own.

Diagnostic.description: One code, the phases its table assigns it, and the severity at which its table declares it.

phases.description: Every phase that may report the code, in phase order. A warnings table assigns no phase, so a warning lists every phase: it is reported in the phase that checks the requirement it names.

severities.description: The severities the code's table declares it at: ERROR for a diagnostics table, WARNING for a warnings table.

declaredBy.description: The family whose spec.md declares the code.

requirement.description: For a warning, the requirement ID its table names: the SHOULD-level rule the warning reports.
